answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our network deploys a cryptographic trust bridge where identity verification scales via quadratic collateral bonding. Each new node must stake tokens while verifying a historical execution relic—a non-transferable cryptographic proof of past valid computation. The protocol uses the raven gossip layer to track identity clusters, imposing superlinear staking costs $O(N^2)$ so mass cloning becomes economically non-viable.
